title: Staff to supporters:
title_short: Nashville · We Couldn't Do This Without You
headline: Seven Soles4Souls staff, in the middle of a shoe distribution, answer one question: what would you say to the people who support us?
story: Every staff interview ended with the same question. This cut is only those answers, one after another, over the kids they were fitting that morning. It is the donor thank-you the client asked for on the day (a group “thank you” from the Soles4Souls team).
Seven voices: Laura, Alex, Skyler, Teresa, Lisa, Nicole, Jamie. Short bites, quick cuts, warm. The ask rides the end card, not the speech.
do: Frame 1 is Laura on camera with the hook text already on screen at 0:00.
Keep each bite short. If a line runs long, cut it at the comma.
Alternate on-camera and B-roll of kids getting shoes so it never feels like a wall of talking heads.
Name super for each speaker at her or his first line, small, lower left, 2 seconds, never at 0:00.
Look for the group thank-you on scrub (see the open decision). If it exists, it goes right before the end card.
dont: No logo, no title card, no fade at 0:00.
Do NOT use the staff retreat and 250-kids lines (Jamie 00:22–00:30, Nicole 00:14–00:20). Those belong to the recap cut.
Do NOT use Alex's “happiest I've ever been” line. That is his own cut.
Do NOT use Lisa's false starts (MVI_4379 00:26–00:39). Cut in at “I would thank supporters”.
Do NOT put any number about money on screen.
